definitions: A musical instrument of African origin, similar to a xylophone but with a more resonant tone, having a series of wooden bars struck with mallets and typically having resonators beneath the bars.
A type of large xylophone with wooden bars and tubular resonators, played with mallets.
examples: The marimba's rich sound filled the hall.
She learned to play the marimba at a young age.
The band featured a marimba solo.
